sentences.en: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
sentences.zh: 你见过富士山吗？它的美丽无法用言语形容。

sentences.en: The problem is beyond the scope of my understanding.
sentences.zh: 这个问题超出了我的理解范围。

sentences.en: I'm afraid the book is beyond the reach of his understanding.
sentences.zh: 恐怕这本书超出了他的理解能力。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：红极一时的乐队“Beyond”就是这个词
